query: SELECT t.name, (SELECT v FROM (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(s.value #>> '{}'), ''), t.logo_url) AS v) l WHERE length(v) <= 280000) AS logo_url, (SELECT v FROM (SELECT NULLIF(btrim(b.value #>> '{}'), '') AS v) n WHERE length(v) <= 280000) AS name_banner_url, NULLIF(concat_ws(', ', NULLIF(btrim(t.address_line1), ''), NULLIF(btrim(t.address_line2), ''), NULLIF(btrim(t.city), ''), gs.name, NULLIF(btrim(t.pincode), '')), '') AS address, NULLIF(btrim(t.phone), '') AS phone, NULLIF(btrim(t.registration_no), '') AS registration_no FROM tenants t LEFT JOIN geo_states gs ON gs.id = t.state_id LEFT JOIN tenant_settings s ON s.tenant_id = t.id AND s.category = 'branding' AND s.key = 'logo_url' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN tenant_settings b ON b.tenant_id = t.id AND b.category = 'branding' AND b.key = 'name_banner_url' AND b.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.id = $1 AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
